description: This file contains a JavaScript module that defines underscore.js utilities, including a custom templating function, and includes logic for loading external resources, Google Analytics, and a 'Learn' class for fetching and displaying issue counts and demo links related to a TodoMVC example.

classes.name: Learn
classes.description: A class for loading and displaying issue counts and demo links for a TodoMVC framework.

methods.name: Learn.prototype.append
methods.description: Appends a learn information block to the document, customizing links based on options.

methods.name: Learn.prototype.fetchIssueCount
methods.description: Fetches the number of open issues from GitHub API and updates the page.
